## Summary

Describe the user problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Evidence and testing

- [ ] Code compiled or relevant checks passed (or I explain why I could not run them).
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior where practical.
- [ ] I checked for unintended changes to control comparison, blinding, candidate thresholds, evidence language, and privacy boundaries.
- [ ] No secrets, personal footage, identifying experiment data, or restricted assets are included.

## Reproduction or screenshots

Add only safe, redacted images or a licensed synthetic/public fixture. Give clear reproduction steps for UI changes.

## Scientific interpretation

Explain how the change preserves measurement limitations. Detector output does not establish language or an extraordinary origin.
